test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

The meeting was called off / due to a medical emergency of / the manager of the company.

options.text: due to a medical emergency of

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sentence** "The meeting was called off due to a medical emergency of the manager of the company." is grammatically correct as it stands.
 
• **The use **of "due to a medical emergency of the manager of the company" is appropriate and conveys the intended meaning correctly.

Therefore, there is no grammatical error in the sentence, and the correct answer is **Option 1** (No error).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 **("due to a medical emergency of") is correct as it stands and does not contain an error.
 
• **Option 3** ("the manager of the company.") is also correct and grammatically sound.
 
• **Option 4 **("The meeting was called off") is a grammatically correct segment as well.
